The '''Dragontooth Club''' is a [[Weapons#Club|club weapon]] that can be looted in the [[Volcano Dungeon]] when opening Dungeon Chests.

==Notes==
* The Dragontooth Club deals the highest damage of any weapon in the game when it scores a critical hit.
